**Objective 5 — DONE.** Ticket status is **Ready**. The ticket already had a customer and two saved parts, so whatever the app's preconditions for Ready are (at minimum a customer; the parts were present), they were already satisfied. **Objective 6 — DONE.** Both parts were deleted (each via the row's Delete button plus an in-page "Confirm / Delete part" dialog, both accepted; the table settled to "No parts on this ticket yet."). The ticket was then archived via "Archive ticket" (applied immediately, no precondition; an "Archived" badge appeared and the button became "Unarchive ticket").
